Gameplay

How to play

Explore a vast world, mine valuable resources, craft equipment, and grow stronger. Slime Runes offers a simple yet rewarding gameplay loop for everyone.

01EXPLORE

Explore different regions, meet NPCs, and discover hidden areas.

02MINE

Gather ores, crystals, and rare materials from mining spots.

03COLLECT

Store your resources in inventory and collect rare items.

04CRAFT

Use materials to craft weapons, tools, and equipment.

05UPGRADE

Upgrade your gear, increase mining speed, and unlock new areas.
